description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for media tools, including configuration defaults, model resolution, and result building, specific to the openclaw project.

methods.name: applyImageModelConfigDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for image models in OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: applyImageGenerationModelConfigDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for image generation models in OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: applyAgentDefaultModelConfig
methods.description: Helper function to apply default model configuration based on key.

methods.name: resolveMediaToolLocalRoots
methods.description: Resolves local media roots based on workspace directory and options.

methods.name: resolvePromptAndModelOverride
methods.description: Determines prompt and model override from arguments or defaults.

methods.name: buildTextToolResult
methods.description: Builds a structured result object for text tool output.

methods.name: resolveModelFromRegistry
methods.description: Resolves a model from the registry given provider and model ID.

methods.name: resolveModelRuntimeApiKey
methods.description: Resolves and sets the runtime API key for a model, returning the key.
